Hotels & stays

Find the stay, then do the day

Where the night belongs

Wake up in the city, not just land there.

Pick a stay by how the morning should feel. Live rooms open on the next page. Never a made-up rate.

BetaAsk Vero

Tell Vero how you want to wake up.

Describe the stay in your own words. Vero shortlists live rooms. Never a brochure price.

Try asking

Plan the rest

The stay is only one night of the trip

FlightsLive fares to the city you just picked Explore ExperiencesTours and tables once you have a key Explore

Questions

Good to know before you sleep there

Are the hotel prices real?

Yes. Nightly rates come live from our hotel partners for your dates. If a rate changes before you pay, we show the new total first.

When do I pay?

Only after you review guests and the full stay total. Nothing is charged before that, and payment is handled securely by our payment partner.

How long is a room held?

Once you select a room, it is held for a short time while you check out. The payment page shows how long is left.

Do photos guarantee a room view?

No. Photos show the property. Ocean, mountain, or courtyard views are confirmed on the live rate. We never invent a view.

Can I book for more than one room?

Yes. Add rooms and guests in the search dock, then enter each guest at checkout.

Which currencies can I pay in?

Choose your currency in the header on the results page. Totals are shown in it wherever the supplier allows.
